prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick actions, mute sound, or minimize to the system tray.", "Got It, Take Me Home"]
1: ["Signing In Keeps Your Pets Safe", "Log into your existing account to automatically sync and restore all previously created desktop pets and progress.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled", "Continue to Sign In"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Personality", "Select how your desktop pet behaves during your workday.", "Playful, Calm, Focused, Energetic", "Confirm Temperament"]
3: ["Your Companion is Ready to Adopt!", "Verify your pet's appearance and name before finalizing your adoption certificate.", "Pet Name"]
4: ["Bringing Your Desktop Pet to Life...", "Our engine is rendering your pet's desktop physics and animations.", "Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime on your desktop to summon your pet!"]
5: ["Signing in automatically syncs your saved pets and progress from cloud backup."]
6: ["Feel free to work on other tasks; we will alert you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet walking on your screen or find the pet icon in your system tray to adjust volume, toggle visibility, or open settings."]
8: []
9: ["HD Render & Cloud Save Verified"]
